title: CTRL-3: physical reach acceptance
why: Scout: jn7fkwmxbs78bqcxdjrn3bvnkd8h9a1b Task: js74bcx1cq2w2wgy2q9jce93ms8grs8s. Dex3 contacts block legacy scripted counter reach; policy joint actions must own contact.

ops.text: After each arm motion, the executor re-reads the physical palm, re-solves IK from measured state, and reports measured residual when real contact blocks the reach.
At authored south counter pose, foundation model joint actions touch the counter top within 10 simulated seconds; physics measures contact, without scripted reach or penetration.
